decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:  Unreferenced Construction Logistics Plan, Unreferenced Daylight & Sunlight Report, Unreferenced Design and Access Statement, Unreferenced Design Fire Strategy, Unreferenced Drainage Assessment Form, Unreferenced Flood Risk and Surface Water Drainage Assessment, Unreferenced Noise Impact Assessment to a Proposed Residential Development, Unreferenced Planning Application Checklist for Floor Risk and Drainage, Unreferenced Planning Statement incorporating Statement of Community Involvement, Unreferenced Planning & Heritage Statement incorporating Statement of Community Involvement, Unreferenced Preliminary Groundwater Screening Assessment - Technical Note, Unreferenced Sustainability Report, Unreferenced Transport Statement, 3667H-LB-XX-ZZ-DR-A-101000, 3667H-LB-XX-ZZ-DR-A-101001 Received:  05 October 2021;  3667H-LB-GC-00-DR-A-120000-T5, 3667H-LB-GC-01-DR-A-120001-T5, 3667H-LB-GC-02-DR-A-120002-T4, 3667H-LB-GC-03-DR-A-120003-T4, 3667H-LB-GC-04-DR-A-120004-T3, 3667H-LB-GC-ZZDR-A-130000-T3, 3667H-LB-GC-ZZ-DR-A-130001, 3667H-LB-GC-ZZ-DR-A-140000-T2, 3667H-LB-GC-ZZDR-A-140000-T2, 3667H-LB-GC-ZZ-DR-A-300000-T2, 3667H-LB-GC-ZZ-DR-A-300001-T2, 3667H-LB-XX-00-DR-L-200000-P5, 3667H-LB-XX-00-DR-L-210000-P5  Received: 04 May 2022;  WIE-17247-SA-95-0042-A01  Received: 25 August 2022.  

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall be constructed with the external materials previously approved by Approval of Details Consent P/2023/0465 only and be permanently maintained as such thereafter.  

Reasons:  To enhance the character and appearance of the area and neighbour living conditions in accordance with Local Plan Policies CC1 and CC2.

Condition : 4 - The hereby permitted development's cycle storage facilities shall be constructed in accordance with the design previously agreed by Approval of Details Consent P/2023/2417 only, made available to occupants upon first occupation of the development and maintained as such thereafter without obstruction.  

Reasons:  To ensure that secure cycle spaces are provided and retained for the occupiers of the development to promote active and sustainable travel, in accordance with London Plan Policy T5 and Local Plan Policy EC2.

Condition : 5 - The development hereby permitted shall be implemented fully in accordance with the Construction Logistics Plan previously agreed by Approval of Details Consent P/2022/4064 at all times.  

Reasons:  To protect the accessibility and safety of the public highway network, quality of the local environment, public health and neighbouring living conditions in accordance with Local Plan Policies EQ2, EQ3, EQ4, EQ5, EQ6 and EC2.

Condition : 6 - A. The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved 'Sustainability Report' (PA1584 Rev B), received on 21 September 2021.  

B. Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure/ National Calculation Method) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development had been constructed in accordance with the approved 'Sustainability Report' (PA1584 Rev B).  

Reasons:  To ensure that the development makes the fullest contribution to minimising greenhouse gas emissions which contribute to climate change in accordance with London Plan Policy SI2 and Local Plan Policy EQ1.

Condition : 7 - Prior to first occupation of the building(s) evidence (schedule of fittings and manufacturers literature) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the development has achieved an internal water use of 105 litres per person per day or less.  

Reason:  To protect and conserve water supplies and resources in accordance with London Plan Policy SI5 and Local Plan Policy EQ2.

Condition : 8 - The development hereby permitted shall be implemented fully in accordance with the material sustainability details previously agreed by Approval of Details Consent P/2023/3670.  

At least 50% of timber and timber products used in the construction of the development hereby permitted shall be accredited by the Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) scheme.  
No construction or insulation materials shall be used that would release toxins into the internal and external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone.  

Reasons:  To ensure the sustainable sourcing of materials in accordance with London Plan Policy SI2 and the Mayor of London's Sustainable Design and Construction SPG.

Condition : 9 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in strict compliance with the drainage strategy details previously approved by Approval of Details Consent P/2023/1186 and be permanently maintained as such thereafter.  

Reason: To prevent the risk of flooding to and from the site in accordance with Local Plan Policy SI13.

Condition : 10 - No part of the development hereby permitted shall be occupied until evidence (photographs and copies of installation contracts, along with a written confirmation) has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the sustainable drainage scheme hereby approved has been completed in accordance with the submitted final detailed drainage designs.  

The sustainable drainage scheme shall be managed and maintained thereafter in accordance with the agreed management and maintenance plan for all of the proposed drainage components.  

Reasons:  To ensure that methods to mitigate the risk of surface water flooding have been implemented as agreed and that the drainage system would be suitably managed in accordance with Local Plan Policy EQ3.

Condition : 11 - No part of the development hereby permitted shall be occupied until the hard and soft landscaping scheme previously agreed by Approval of Details Consent P/2023/2417 has been implemented, which shall be permanently retained as such thereafter.  
Any trees or plants that, within five years of planting, die, are cut down, uprooted, destroyed or become (in the opinion of the Local Planning Authority) seriously damaged or defective, shall be replaced with another tree or plant of the same size and species within the first planting season following its death, removal, uprooting or destruction, unless the Local Planning Authority gives its prior written approval to any variation.  

Reason:  To protect the appearance of the site and surrounding area, provide adequate play equipment and enhance green infrastructure, biodiversity and fire safety in accordance with Local Plan Policies CC1, CC2 and GB7.

Condition : 12 - During the course of the development:

a. The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional land contamination is discovered during the course of the development.  A competent person shall assess the additional land contamination and submit appropriate amendments to the previously approved decontamination scheme in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.  

Before the development is first brought into use:

b. The decontamination scheme previously agreed by Approval of Details Consent P/2022/3273, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.  

Reasons:  Land contamination is known or suspected within the site due to a former land use.  The Local Planning Authority therefore wishes to ensure that the development can be implemented and occupied with adequate regard for public and environmental safety in accordance with London Plan Policy EQ8.  

Supporting Notes:

a. The land contamination validation report shall revisit the site's conceptual model and provide evidence that each aspect of the decontamination scheme was carried out correctly and successfully. This report shall prove that the development is suitable for its new use.  

b. The Council requests that site investigation reports and site plans be sent electronically to landquality@hounslow.gov.uk or by post on a CD or DVD wherever possible.

Condition : 13 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the Local Planning Authority shall be informed of the agreed naming and numbering of the proposed dwelling so that arrangements can be put in place to ensure that, with the exception of a person eligible for a disabled person's badge issued pursuant to Section 21 of the Chronically Sick and Disabled Persons Act 1970 (or similar legislation), no resident of the development shall obtain a resident's parking permit.  Any occupiers of the approved development shall surrender any such permit wrongly issued or held.  

Reason:  To protect the free flow and safety of traffic on nearby highways and support sustainable transport objectives in accordance with Local Plan Policy EC2.

Condition : 14 - Prior to the occupation of the development hereby permitted, the development's waste storage facilities and collection arrangements previously agreed by Approval of Details Consent P/2023/2417 shall be fully implemented and permanently retained as such thereafter.  

Reason:  To protect the character and appearance of the area, neighbour living conditions, quality of the local environment and public health and prevent obstruction to the public highway network in accordance with Local Plan Policies CC1, CC2 and EC2.

Condition : 15 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in any external walls of the development hereby permitted without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.  

Reasons: To protect neighbour living conditions and ensure that the accommodation provided would be appropriate and respect the character and appearance of the area in accordance with Local Plan Policies CC1, CC2 and CC4.

Condition : 16 - All Non-Road Mobile Machinery (NRMM) used during the course of the development that is within the scope of the GLA 'Control of Dust and Emissions during Construction and Demolition' Supplementary Planning Guidance (SPG) dated July 2014, or any successor document, shall comply with the emissions requirements therein.  

Reason:  To protect air quality in accordance with Local Plan Policy EQ4.

Condition : 17 - Prior to the occupation of the development hereby permitted, an Electric Vehicle Charging Point shall be installed within the site's front car park in accordance in accordance with the design and technical details previously agreed by Approval of Details Consent P/2022/4064, following which post-installation photographic evidence shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval, and permanently retained in a usable condition at all times thereafter.  

Reason:  To support sustainable transport objectives in accordance with London Plan Policy T6.1 and Local Plan Policy EC2.

Condition : 18 - The development shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the wheelchair accessible design details previously agreed by Approval of Details Consent P/2023/0678 and permanently retained as such thereafter.  

Reason:  To ensure a socially inclusive and sustainable development in accordance with London Plan Policy D5.

Condition : 19 - Prior to the occupation of the development hereby permitted, the tree planting specification previously agreed by Approval of Details Consent P/2022/3831 shall be fully implemented in accordance with British Standard 8545:2014 (or an equivalent British Standard if replaced).

Any trees that, within five years of planting, die, are cut down, uprooted, destroyed or become (in the opinion of the Local Planning Authority) seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced with trees of a similar size and species within the first planting season following its death, removal, uprooting or destruction. 

Reasons:  To enhance the character and appearance of the area and promote biodiversity in accordance with Local Plan Policies CC1, CC2 and GB7.
description: Variation of Condition 6 (Energy Strategy) to remove its requirement to report energy consumption performance data to an online monitoring platform every eighteen months for three years following the operational commencement date of the previously approved flats' energy generation equipment of Planning Permission P/2021/3807 approved 13/10/2022 for the 'Erection of a four storey residential block comprising twelve flats with three car parking spaces, cycle and waste storage, landscaping and boundary treatment following demolition of existing garages'.
